Note.NoteText:
Anywhere to Brazil: From anywhere to Brazil:
- Brazilian Customs System (Siscarga) requires previous manifest about any cargo; pre-alert with drafts for checking PRIOR to vessel departure is required.
- Original B/Ls type are mandatory - SeaWayBill / Express BL not allowed (both HBL and MBL)
- CNPJ code (Tax ID) has to be entered for consignee and notify fields (both HBL and MBL); Notify field cannot be blank
- Use Brazilian Customs Tariff Numbers (NCM) - Do not register foreign HS Codes
- Wooden package treatment must be mentioned into goods description. Please choose one of these options: > Wooden package: Treated and certified (Packages have been treated and/or fumigated and include a certificate) > Wooden package: Processed (plywood) > Wooden package: Not applicable (only in case there is no wooden material)
- Freight rates must be mentioned (HBL = Selling Rate > MBL = purchase). Terms like "As Agreed" or "As arranged" is not alowed.
- HBL sum of rates must be higher or equal MBL value (over manifestation is not allowed).
